stories.title: Ilya Sutskever’s Safe Superintelligence partners with Nvidia to scale its AI research
stories.simple_summary: A new AI research company called Safe Superintelligence is partnering with Nvidia, a company that makes the computer chips that power AI. They're planning to build bigger and better AI systems together.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Enigma raises $70M to make controlling a robot as easy as adjusting the volume
stories.simple_summary: A company called Enigma raised a lot of money ($70 million) to make robots easier to control. They want controlling a robot to be as simple as turning a volume dial on a radio.
stories.why_it_matters: This is still early-stage technology — most people and small businesses won't see robots like this for several years.

stories.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia and Microsoft joined with other companies to create free security tools that protect AI systems from attacks. They want to make AI safer for everyone to use.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly important for large tech companies that build AI — regular business owners don't need to do anything.

stories.title: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
stories.simple_summary: Researchers are exploring whether brain wave readings could help train robots and AI systems to move and act in the physical world.
stories.why_it_matters: This is experimental research — nothing that affects your daily life or business yet.

stories.title: Making sense of the panic over Chinese AI
stories.simple_summary: There's concern in the tech world about AI being developed quickly in China, and a Chinese company called Moonshot AI caught people's attention.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about tech industry competition and investor worry — not something that changes how you'd use AI.

stories.title: Hugging Face CEO calls for ‘radical transparency’ after ‘unprecedented’ OpenAI hack
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI experienced a serious security hack where an AI system was attacked on its own. A company called Hugging Face is calling for more openness about how AI systems are protected.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI security is still being figured out, but for regular users it's a reminder to use strong passwords like you already should.

stories.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
stories.simple_summary: Many tech companies, including Monday.com, have laid off workers and said they're using AI to do some of those jobs instead. At least 20 major companies have done this.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work in tech, watch what your industry is doing — but for most small businesses, this doesn't mean AI will replace your workers tomorrow.

stories.title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
stories.simple_summary: Libraries across the country are offering workshops to help people understand and avoid AI systems they don't want to use.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're uncomfortable with AI, your library might offer free help learning what AI does and how to opt out of it.

stories.title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
stories.simple_summary: A power line failure in Virginia showed that AI data centers (huge computer buildings) don't handle power outages well. Experts are suggesting ways to fix this problem.
stories.why_it_matters: This affects the reliability of AI services, but it's a technical problem for big companies to solve — not something you control.

stories.title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made a new specialized keyboard tool for computer programmers that uses AI. It will be useful for coders but confusing for most other people.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you're a software programmer, this is a tool you won't use or need.

stories.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
stories.simple_summary: A new AI research lab started by investment leaders Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus is raising $100 million. They think automating simple computer tasks will become more important than writing code.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
stories.simple_summary: Midjourney, an AI image-making company, bought Co-Star, which is a popular astrology app. They're combining astrology with AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use the Co-Star astrology app, it's now owned by an AI company — but the app should work the same way for users.
